name: stoneridge-equity
description: A fast, dependency-free marketing site for **Stoneridge Equity**, a private equity firm based in Austin, Texas. Static HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework. The design is tuned to feel established and institutional (in the spirit of Blackstone / Warburg Pincus) with a few creative, motion-forward touches (in the spirit of ATX Venture Partners).
